topSpeedMPS.citation: J. Functional Morphology & Kinesiology, 2025, Pre-PHV stage (~12.8yo): on-ice max speed (V0) 8.60+/-0.37 m/s (31 km/h). https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12821503/

avgAccelMPS2.citation: Computed from accel0to10mS via kinematics (d = 0.5*a*t^2, d=10m). Note: this is genuinely LOWER than U11's derived value (5.21) despite U13 having higher top speed -- a real feature of the cited data, not an error. Reduced relative acceleration efficiency during the pre-peak-height-velocity growth spurt is a documented phenomenon in youth athletic development; this profile preserves the real pattern rather than smoothing it into an artificial monotonic curve.

turningRadiusM.citation: No published turning-radius figure exists at any age. Estimated as v^2 / (0.6 * avgAccelMPS2) -- see docs/scenario-engine/physics-sourcing.md for the assumption.

stoppingDistanceM.citation: No published stopping-distance figure exists at any age. Estimated as v^2 / (2 * avgAccelMPS2).

reactionDelayS.citation: No ice-hockey or youth-hockey reaction-time study exists at any age. 250-350ms range built from adult non-hockey athlete proxy data (PMC11207928), applied flat across all bands.

passSpeedMPS.citation: No youth ice-hockey pass-velocity study exists. Scaled from the U18 pass-speed reference (18 m/s) by this band's real topSpeedMPS ratio to U18's.

iceDecelerationMPS2.citation: mu*g using Hache's puck-on-ice friction coefficient (~0.1, https://physicsworld.com/a/physics-on-ice/) and standard gravity. Real, age-independent physical constant.
